_doc: Single-shard >= 30 GB copies (1 primary, 0 replicas), used with coldbench --indices this-file and the SAME arms file. Build with indexprep.py single-shard, force-merge to a fixed count (forcemerge), and the 1-segment variant with clone --segments 1 (a second indices file whose names point at the *_1seg copies). Set segments_per_shard to the recorded count.
